patterns.name: Delivery theatre
patterns.description: Governance activity is high while outcome evidence is low.

patterns.name: Fragile release path
patterns.description: Engineering foundations cannot support the release cadence being sponsored.

patterns.name: Absent sponsorship
patterns.description: Decisions, risk and prioritisation all lack an active sponsor.

patterns.name: Balanced maturity
patterns.description: No section is materially behind the others.

definitions.name: Leadership Vacuum
definitions.description: Sponsorship, governance and decision ownership are simultaneously ineffective.
definitions.businessImpact: Executive ownership is inconsistent, slowing strategic decision making, reducing accountability and increasing delivery risk.

definitions.name: Governance Theatre
definitions.description: Governance ceremonies run while decisions and portfolio visibility do not improve.
definitions.businessImpact: Governance consumes senior capacity without improving decision quality, creating a false sense of control while risk accumulates unseen.

definitions.name: Firefighting Culture
definitions.description: Predictability, systemic delivery risk and engineering assurance all degrade together.
definitions.businessImpact: Teams operate reactively, consuming capacity on unplanned work, eroding forecast reliability and burning out delivery leadership.

definitions.name: Benefits Drift
definitions.description: Benefits ownership is weak and adoption of change is not tracked.
definitions.businessImpact: Investment is committed without a credible line of sight to benefits, so value leaks quietly and reinvestment decisions are made on unreliable evidence.

definitions.name: Fragile Engineering Base
definitions.description: Engineering assurance risk is present and delivery predictability cannot compensate.
definitions.businessImpact: Change carries unquantified technical risk, making release dates unreliable and increasing the cost of every subsequent change.
definitions.explanationTemplate: Fragile engineering base indicated by {count} rule(s): {rules} (confidence {confidence}).

definitions.name: Change Absorption Overload
definitions.description: Change adoption risk combines with portfolio visibility gaps.
definitions.businessImpact: The organisation is asked to absorb more change than it can operationalise, so delivered capability is not converted into working practice.
definitions.explanationTemplate: Change absorption overload confirmed by {count} rule(s): {rules} (confidence {confidence}).

definitions.name: Evidence Poor Assessment
definitions.description: Insufficient assessment evidence undermines the reliability of downstream findings.
definitions.businessImpact: Conclusions rest on partial evidence, so leadership should treat scoring as indicative until the assessment is completed.

definitions.name: Healthy Sponsorship System
definitions.description: Sponsorship and delivery leadership are confirmed effective with no systemic delivery risk.
definitions.businessImpact: Executive sponsorship is translating intent into dependable delivery; the operating model should be protected and reused as a reference pattern.
